senses: (Qal) to be or become wise, act wisely
(Piel) to make wise, teach wisdom, instruct
(Hithpael) to show oneself wise, deceive, show one's wisdom

strongs.def: to be wise (in mind, word or act)
strongs.kjv: [idiom] exceeding, teach wisdom, be (make self, shew self) wise, deal (never so) wisely, make wiser
